title: Dan Campbell: Sam LaPorta's contract comments aren't a distraction for us

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dan Campbell: Sam LaPorta's contract comments aren't a distraction for us
sources.description: Lions tight end Sam LaPorta is in the market for a new contract and he said this week that "it sucks" that one hasn't come together with the team as he plays out the final year of his rookie deal.
